design_description: This jersey takes a minimal, premium black-and-gold approach, combining classic football striping with a restrained luxury aesthetic. The body uses a tone-on-tone vertical stripe pattern, alternating deep black with slightly lighter charcoal-black panels. Because the contrast is deliberately subtle, the stripes add structure and depth while the shirt remains predominantly black. Metallic-style gold accents provide the key contrast: the club crest and star, Momuto branding, and QATAR AIRWAYS main sponsor are all presented in gold. A very thin gold trim around the black crew collar and sleeve cuffs ties these elements together without adding unnecessary visual weight. The layout itself is highly traditional: branding and crest positioned symmetrically on the chest, a large centered sponsor, and virtually no additional graphics beyond a small detail near the lower hem. Overall, it is a clean, elegant and understated design: classic black-on-black football stripes elevated by carefully controlled gold detailing, giving the jersey a refined and prestigious identity.
